arguments.analyst: Observed bright examples include K26R:F84Y and K41R:T43A; N144D is context-dependent, bright with D76N but weaker with M78T. Prioritize menu variants with established bright-associated positions and avoid proline/known low-performing contexts.

decision.critic: Only O rows are measured; the tool estimates are predictions, not fluorescence observations. Evidence is sparse and mutation effects may depend on background.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize C37 (estimate 3.579) and C27 (3.566), which share T43A with observed O7; C23 (3.526) carries F84Y as in bright O3. C19 (3.537) and C18 (3.535) round out the set with similarly high estimates. Testable hypothesis: T43A- or F84Y-bearing candidates will tend to retain high brightness, while outcomes may vary with partner substitutions. Weakness: these candidates do not reproduce the observed mutation backgrounds, so estimates and shared substitutions do not establish measured performance.
